name: IPverse auto-rig
description: Hunyuan3D GLB -> UAL-skeleton rigged.glb + run-cycle preview under OutputPrefix/. Embedded files are filled in by workers/template_loader.load_rig_template().

parameterDefinitions.name: AnimUri
parameterDefinitions.description: s3://bucket/key of ual.glb (UAL clips on the bare skeleton)

parameterDefinitions.name: PoseModelUri
parameterDefinitions.description: s3://bucket/key of the RTMPose-m body7 256x192 ONNX

parameterDefinitions.name: OutputPrefix
parameterDefinitions.description: s3://bucket/prefix for outputs, no trailing slash

parameterDefinitions.name: CondaPackages
parameterDefinitions.default: blender python boto3 ffmpeg onnxruntime pillow numpy
